title: Vickers Wellington BJ879
memorial_details: A plaque mounted on a post, on the ground near the water tower, which commemorates the WW2 Wellington aircrew who crashed at the site.
inscription: MURSLEY PARISH COUNCIL/ IN MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN/ WELLINGTON B.J.879 OF 26 OTU/ CRASHED INTO THE WATER TOWER/ AT 00.15 HRS. 11TH APRIL 1943/ DEDICATED 8TH MAY 1995/ TO COMMEMORATE V.E.DAY/ 1945-1995/ DONATED BY ANGLIAN WATER SERVICES LTD
community_connection: The memorial was donated by Anglian Water Services Ltd.
